description: This source file defines a FastAPI router for managing medical records, including CRUD operations with role-based access control, interfacing with a MongoDB database.

methods.name: MedicalRecord _record_from_doc(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Maps a MongoDB document to a MedicalRecord model.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_patient_id_for_user(db, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves patient ID associated with a user ID from the database.

methods.name: List[MedicalRecord] list_medical_records( patient_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by patient id (required for doctors)"), user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )
methods.description: Lists medical records accessible to the current user, with filtering based on role.

methods.name: MedicalRecord create_medical_record( payload: MedicalRecordCreate, _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required_strict(["admin", "doctor"])), )
methods.description: Creates a new medical record; accessible only to admins and doctors.

methods.name: MedicalRecord get_medical_record( record_id: str = Path(..., description="Medical record id"), user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific medical record with RBAC checks.

methods.name: MedicalRecord update_medical_record( record_id: str, payload: MedicalRecordUpdate, _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required(["admin", "doctor"])), )
methods.description: Updates entries in an existing medical record; restricted to admins and doctors.

methods.name: None delete_medical_record( record_id: str, _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required_strict(["admin"])), )
methods.description: Deletes a medical record; restricted to admins.
